_comment: Provider peak windows: hours when the same work costs more of a plan or a balance.
Read by scripts/peak-windows.mjs. Used by cost-ledger.mjs (tags every turn, measures the meters inside vs outside each window)
and route-worker.mjs (a cost penalty on affected models while a window is open).
status 'published': the provider states it, so the router applies the penalty.
status 'measure': not confirmed for how WE pay, so the router applies the penalty only after the ledger's window test says
the meter really moves faster inside the window (verdict 'passes_through'). Until then it is only measured.
applies.model: regex on the catalog id / ledger model id. Free models (catalog cost 'free') are never penalised.
hours: [start, end) in the window's own time zone; days: three-letter weekday names in that zone.

windows.label: Anthropic peak
windows.effect: Claude's 5-hour session limit drains faster; off-peak gets double the usual rate.

windows.label: DeepSeek peak
windows.effect: DeepSeek's own API bills V4 models at 2x in these hours. Unknown whether OpenCode Go / Zen pass it on.
windows.days_note: Weekdays per codingplans.dev; hwbusters gives the same hours without days. DeepSeek's pricing page was not reachable when this was written - check api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing and fix days/hours here if they differ.

test._comment: Window test thresholds (cost-ledger). A meter span counts when >= model_share of its weighted tokens come from the window's models. Verdict needs min_spans and min_points on each side; ratio = meter points per weighted Mtok inside / outside.
